sql.query: UPDATE tbl_contracting_entities ce SET ce.isDefault=0 WHERE ce.tenantId=:tenantId AND :isDefault=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ce.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)

INSERT INTO tbl_contracting_entities (id,tenantId,tradingName,legalName,registrationNumber,vatNumber,addressLine1,addressLine2,townCity,countyRegion,postcode,country,telephone,email,website,signatoryName,signatoryTitle,defaultPaymentTerms,contractFooter,isDefault,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT NULLIF(:id,''),:tenantId,NULLIF(:tradingName,''),:legalName,NULLIF(:registrationNumber,''),NULLIF(:vatNumber,''),NULLIF(:addressLine1,''),NULLIF(:addressLine2,''),NULLIF(:townCity,''),NULLIF(:countyRegion,''),NULLIF(:postcode,''),NULLIF(:country,''),NULLIF(:telephone,''),NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:website,''),NULLIF(:signatoryName,''),NULLIF(:signatoryTitle,''),NULLIF(:paymentTerms,''),NULLIF(:footer,''),:isDefault,:isActive,:userId,:userId2 FROM DUAL WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(:legalName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tradingName=VALUES(tradingName),legalName=VALUES(legalName),registrationNumber=VALUES(registrationNumber),vatNumber=VALUES(vatNumber),addressLine1=VALUES(addressLine1),addressLine2=VALUES(addressLine2),townCity=VALUES(townCity),countyRegion=VALUES(countyRegion),postcode=VALUES(postcode),country=VALUES(country),telephone=VALUES(telephone),email=VALUES(email),website=VALUES(website),signatoryName=VALUES(signatoryName),signatoryTitle=VALUES(signatoryTitle),defaultPaymentTerms=VALUES(defaultPaymentTerms),contractFooter=VALUES(contractFooter),isDefault=VALUES(isDefault),isActive=VALUES(isActive),modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
